```{r load-data}
# Read a package dataset from inst/extdata/ (dev-first, installed fallback).
# Uses readr::read_rds() for .rds, arrow for .parquet, and rio otherwise.
pkg_desc <- if (file.exists("../DESCRIPTION")) {
  "../DESCRIPTION"
} else {
  here::here("DESCRIPTION")
}
default_pkg <- utils::packageName() %||% (
  if (file.exists(pkg_desc)) {
    unname(read.dcf(pkg_desc)[1, "Package"])
  } else {
    ""
  }
)

read_extdata <- function(file_name, pkg_name = default_pkg) {
  candidates <- c(
    here::here("inst", "extdata", file_name),
    if (nzchar(pkg_name) && requireNamespace(pkg_name, quietly = TRUE)) {
      system.file("extdata", file_name, package = pkg_name)
    }
  )
  hits <- candidates[nzchar(candidates) & file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(hits) == 0L) {
    msg_loc <- if (nzchar(pkg_name)) {
      "Checked {.path inst/extdata} and package {.pkg {pkg_name}}."
    } else {
      paste(
        "Checked {.path inst/extdata}; pass {.arg pkg_name} when running",
        "outside the package directory."
      )
    }
    cli::cli_abort(c("Could not find {.file {file_name}}.", "i" = msg_loc))
  }
  if (grepl("\\.rds$", hits[1], ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    readr::read_rds(hits[1])
  } else if (
    grepl("\\.parquet$", hits[1], ignore.case = TRUE) &&
      requireNamespace("arrow", quietly = TRUE)
  ) {
    arrow::read_parquet(hits[1])
  } else {
    rio::import(hits[1])
  }
}

# Uncomment to load files from inst/extdata/ into the global environment:
dataset_names <- c(
  # demographic_data = "demographic_data.rds" # add comma if >1 file
  # treatment_data = "treatment.rds"
)

for (nm in names(dataset_names)) {
  assign(nm, read_extdata(dataset_names[[nm]]), envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```

```{r make-references, include=FALSE}
# automatically create a bib database for loaded R packages & rUM
bib_path <- if (dir.exists("bib")) {
  "bib/packages.bib"
} else {
  here::here("vignettes", "bib", "packages.bib")
}
bib_pkgs <- c(.packages(), "rUM")
if (file.exists(bib_path)) {
  old_pkgs <- stringr::str_match(
    readLines(bib_path, warn = FALSE),
    "^@Manual[{]R-([^,]+),"
  )[, 2]
  old_pkgs <- stats::na.omit(old_pkgs)
  old_pkgs <- old_pkgs[
    vapply(old_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
  ]
  bib_pkgs <- unique(c(bib_pkgs, old_pkgs))
}
knitr::write_bib(bib_pkgs, bib_path)
```
